verdict.rationale: Jan's README states it downloads and runs LLMs such as Llama, Gemma, Qwen and GPT-oss from Hugging Face. Its docs describe entering a Hugging Face model ID (org/model_name) in the Hub search bar, plus importing GGUF files. Downloads can be paused and resumed, and models run locally via llama.cpp. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the Hugging Face download flow, and documentation of supported formats/quantization selection and gated or authenticated Hugging Face repos.
